approvals_consumption_fields_match.name: approvals_consumption_fields_match
approvals_consumption_fields_match.value: ("approvals"."consumed_attempt_id" is null and "approvals"."consumed_at" is null) or ("approvals"."consumed_attempt_id" is not null and "approvals"."consumed_at" is not null)

licenses_parent_matches_kind.name: licenses_parent_matches_kind
licenses_parent_matches_kind.value: ("licenses"."kind" = 'base' and "licenses"."parent_license_id" is null) or ("licenses"."kind" = 'addon' and "licenses"."parent_license_id" is not null and "licenses"."parent_license_id" <> "licenses"."id")

offers_parent_matches_kind.name: offers_parent_matches_kind
offers_parent_matches_kind.value: ("offers"."kind" = 'base' and "offers"."parent_offer_id" is null and "offers"."parent_offer_version" is null) or ("offers"."kind" = 'addon' and "offers"."parent_offer_id" is not null and "offers"."parent_offer_version" is not null and "offers"."parent_offer_id" <> "offers"."id")

payment_attempts_authorization_fields_ma.name: payment_attempts_authorization_fields_match
payment_attempts_authorization_fields_ma.value: ("payment_attempts"."authorization_digest" is null and "payment_attempts"."authorization_valid_until" is null) or ("payment_attempts"."authorization_digest" is not null and "payment_attempts"."authorization_valid_until" is not null)

purchases_parent_matches_kind.name: purchases_parent_matches_kind
purchases_parent_matches_kind.value: ("purchases"."kind" = 'base' and "purchases"."parent_purchase_id" is null) or ("purchases"."kind" = 'addon' and "purchases"."parent_purchase_id" is not null and "purchases"."parent_purchase_id" <> "purchases"."id")

purchases_approval_fields_match_status.name: purchases_approval_fields_match_status
purchases_approval_fields_match_status.value: ("purchases"."status" in ('quoted', 'refused', 'expired')) or ("purchases"."status" in ('approved', 'reserved', 'payment_pending', 'settled', 'issuing', 'ready', 'failed_no_settlement') and "purchases"."approval_fingerprint" is not null and "purchases"."approved_at" is not null)

purchases_settled_at_matches_status.name: purchases_settled_at_matches_status
purchases_settled_at_matches_status.value: ("purchases"."status" in ('settled', 'issuing', 'ready') and "purchases"."settled_at" is not null) or ("purchases"."status" not in ('settled', 'issuing', 'ready') and "purchases"."settled_at" is null)

reservations_state_fields_match.name: reservations_state_fields_match
reservations_state_fields_match.value: ("reservations"."state" = 'active' and "reservations"."settled_at" is null and "reservations"."released_at" is null) or ("reservations"."state" = 'settled' and "reservations"."settled_at" is not null and "reservations"."released_at" is null) or ("reservations"."state" = 'released' and "reservations"."released_at" is not null and "reservations"."settled_at" is null)
